mapper.policy_basis: Verified consent is required. Enterprise, team size 100+, or a risk flag requires a separate human approval flow. Caller-supplied approval cannot clear the gate. This tool never sends or writes externally.

metadata.notes: Connection-free classroom MCP tool. Import into Make, set scheduling to On demand, and expose it through a Make MCP Toolbox. It prepares a reviewable draft but cannot approve, send, or write to a CRM.
